pairs.l: 1 — chose what they wanted to study AFTER choosing where?
2 — always knew what they wanted to study?
3 — applied to a university because of its fame?
4 — wanted a course that focused on practical work?
5 — says they enjoyed themselves while studying?
8 — was influenced by their parents when choosing their course?
9 — was given advice by a teacher on what to choose and why?
10 — chose their course on the basis of future career prospects?
11 — thought they had a stroke of luck in the end?

r1.exp: 1=B (Brenda: chose Loughborough first from brochure, then picked the course). 2=F (Fahima: 'early on I began to develop an appetite for words and literature'). 3=C (Caitlin: 'I was in it for the glory' and wanted Oxford). 4=D (Danny: 'produce work that I could show to potential employers'). 5=D (Danny: 'it was both useful and a lot of fun'). 6=C (Caitlin: 'believed I didn't need any advice'). 7=A (Arnold: head of sixth form wanted Literature at Oxford, Arnold chose marketing). 8=D (Danny: 'parents, who recommended a product Design course'). 9=A (Arnold: 'my head of sixth form was keen for me to study Literature at Oxford... everyone would like to hire an Oxford graduate'). 10=E (Earl: 'University of Warwick has the highest employment rate for graduates'). 11=C (Caitlin: 'Fortunately, and despite all this, I was given a conditional offer'). 12=A (Arnold: 'helped me get a placement doing marketing for a multinational company').

r13.exp: 'I COULDN'T WAIT for when we went to the GYM and could run around' — tjelesni odgoj bio je najomiljeniji. Engleski mu je bio najbolji predmet, ali VOLIO je sport = A.

r14.exp: 'I had NO SENSE OF DIRECTION and COULDN'T THINK OF AN ALTERNATIVE' = nije znao što drugo raditi = D.

r15.exp: 'I didn't feel that I was GOING ANYWHERE, or DOING ANYTHING WITH MY LIFE. I needed a new direction' = osjećao da gubi vrijeme = B.

r16.exp: 'Gave me lots of MATERIAL FOR MY FUTURE BOOKS... contact with all sorts of joys and tragedies' = korisno iskustvo = A.

r17.exp: 'Wanted to use fantasy so we see the REALITIES OF OUR SOCIETY from a different perspective' = odražavaju realni svijet = C.

r18.exp: 'It's something I JUST HAVE TO DO. Don't ask me why' = ne može drukčije = D (he can't help himself).

r19.exp: 'Efficiency vs. conservation. (19)___. Examples include turning down thermostat or walking to shops.' → H: That's a broader term which includes changing efficiency but also dropping a service (= conservation). Definira 'conservation'.

r20.exp: 'Spending money up-front. (20)___. This makes efficiency improvements attractive.' → B: In many cases this initial investment will be paid back in the form of reduced energy costs. Objašnjava zašto je ulaganje isplativo.

r21.exp: 'For homes in cool countries: insulation and efficient appliances. (21)___. Many achieved 25% savings.' → A: Non-domestic buildings, on the other hand, need ventilation and air-conditioning. Kontrast: domovi → poslovne zgrade.

r22.exp: 'New equipment and better re-use of waste heat. (22)___. Also, efficient motors save 20-25%.' → G: For instance, a hot pipe containing a chemical can be used to warm up other chemicals. Konkretni primjer ponovne upotrebe otpadne topline.

r23.exp: 'Important to consider efficiency of power source. (23)___. But only if electricity comes from fossil fuels.' → D: Switching from gas boiler to electric heater may increase energy use. 'But only if...' = kvalifikacija rečenice D.

r24.exp: 'Always a good idea. (24)___. For example, insulating home — can become more economical OR increase comfort at same cost.' → F: Whether it results in energy savings depends on what you do with the money you saved.

r25.exp: 'Would never be detected, NOR would we be punished' — 'nor' za dvije negativne koordinatne surečenice: neither... nor ili not... nor.

r26.exp: 'Loss of sleep or the LIKE' — 'the like' = slično tome, i tome slično (= and similar things). Fiksni izraz.

r27.exp: 'Would it MAKE sense to tell the truth' — fiksna kolokacija: make sense = ima smisla.

r28.exp: 'The prudent COURSE of action' — fiksna kolokacija: course of action = tijek/pravac djelovanja.

r29.exp: 'One recent study HAS LAID the groundwork' — present perfect aktiv: lay → laid → has laid (= postaviti temelje, lay the groundwork).

r30.exp: 'Half were asked to stop lying, and THE OTHER half were not' — 'the other' za drugu od dviju jednakih skupina: one half... the other half.

r31.exp: 'Took WEEKLY polygraph tests' — prilog 'weekly' modificira glagol/imenicu (= jednom tjedno). Kontekst: periodično ispitivanje.

r32.exp: 'Seven FEWER mental and physical health complaints' — 'fewer' uz brojivu imenicu množine (complaints). 'Less' uz nebrojivu.

r33.exp: 'Rely ON them' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: rely on = oslanjati se na.

r34.exp: 'TAKE their availability for granted' — fiksna kolokacija: take for granted = uzimati kao nešto samo po sebi razumljivo.

r35.exp: 'Not UNTIL relatively recently' — fiksni izraz: not until = tek tada, tek kada.

r36.exp: 'Difficult to obtain, DESPITE their usefulness' — 'despite' + imenička skupina za kontrast (unatoč korisnosti bili su teško dostupni).

r37.exp: 'Either because they showed markets OR because they contained confidential government information' — fiksni izraz: either... or.

r38.exp: 'TODAY, DUE/OWING/THANKS in large part to the rapid expansion of travel' — 'due to / owing to / thanks to' = zahvaljujući, zbog. Sva tri su prihvatljiva.

r39.exp: 'Resulted IN a level of detail' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: result in = rezultirati nečime, dovesti do.

r40.exp: 'Can work OUT your position' — frazalni glagol: work out = izračunati, odrediti.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA novac/status: financijska sigurnost, moć, društveno prepoznavanje, materijalni komfor. ZA osobnu sreću: zadovoljstvo, sloboda, odnosi s bližnjima, zdrav stil života. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
